Date parsing accepts signed and extended years outside the documented
format. Reject those inputs before validating the calendar date, while
preserving strict leap-day checks and four-digit boundary years.

commitResults.messageTitle: Explain the required email format in errors
commitResults.messageBody:
Malformed addresses containing an at-sign are told to include one. This
misidentifies missing local parts and domains and gives no useful fix.

Describe all required email parts with an example. Keep the existing
validation rules and cover malformed inputs through the Add parser.

commitResults.messageTitle: Report incorrect phone lengths when adding
commitResults.messageBody:
Numeric phone numbers with the wrong length receive a numbers-only
error, leaving users without the eight-digit requirement.

Report the required length for numeric and empty input. Preserve the
character error for non-numeric input and test the Add command boundary.

commitResults.messageTitle: Select the correct contact when categorizing
commitResults.messageBody:
Contacts whose names differ only by case can compare equal even though
they have distinct identities. Updating the second can overwrite the
first and fail while saving history, leaving partial changes.

Require matching identity and details when locating an update target.
Cover case variants, copied targets, filtered indexes and undo/redo.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject circular boss chains when adding contacts
commitResults.messageBody:
Add accepts management cycles that Edit rejects, leaving new contacts
unable to receive unrelated edits.

Share the boss-chain validator between Add and Edit and reject cycles
before adding a contact. Keep empty and external bosses valid, and test
self-reference, indirect cycles, filtered contacts and history safety.
Add clearer messages and test cases
